data.name: Neeyati
data.gender_notes: Neeyati is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Neeyati is derived from the Sanskrit word 'neeyat', meaning 'graceful', 'attractive', or 'alluring'. In Hindu mythology, Neeyati is a name for the goddess Lakshmi, the deity of wealth, prosperity, and beauty. The name Neeyati carries the meaning “Graceful, attractive” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Neeyati usually hope their child will grow to embody graceful, attractive and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Represents the divine grace and allure of the goddess Lakshmi.
data.etymology: Neeyati belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Graceful, attractive.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Neeyati total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.

in_tamil.name: நீயாதி

data.cultural_impact: The name Neeyati, with its inherent charm and grace, has been a popular choice among Hindu families for centuries. It resonates with the rich cultural heritage of India, where beauty and elegance are highly valued and celebrated. The name Neeyati often signifies the aspiration for a beautiful, successful, and prosperous life.
data.spiritual_significance: In spiritual terms, Neeyati is a reminder of the divine grace and blessings that shower upon us. It reminds us to be always attractive in our thoughts, words, and actions, and extend that grace and beauty to the world around us. By invoking the name of Lakshmi, the goddess of abundance, we trust in the providence of the universe to shower us with its gifts. Neeyati, thus, is a beautiful affirmation of our connection to the divine, and our constant remembrance of the inner and outer beauty that we strive to cultivate and maintain.
